text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, it is just that the exact same phrasing
appears in every single letter...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
'I yearn for the Rose's Blooming Smile.'
'Beholding the Rose's Blooming Smile breaks
my heart...' and so forth.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is this 'Rose's Smile'...?
A recent trend? Or could it be...
something paranormal...?

text_block_list.name: Rose's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, I'm always cheering for you!
Your race the other day was truly
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is the greatest of honors.
You have my heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To answer their cheers,
I promise to devote myself to even greater
refinement.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aah! It's blinding!
I-I can't look directly at it...!!

text_block_list.name: Rose's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Lady Rose,
if it wouldn't be too much trouble...
w-would you mind shaking hands with me...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Your cheers always grant me strength.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This is all I can offer in return for now,
but I vow to repay you with victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Too precious...
M-My heart can't take this...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I see.
So that is how the fans describe my smile.
choice_data_list: Yes, the letter was to show gratit...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Good heavens...
When it is I who should be offering
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I hold an enduring sense of deep respect
and affection for all of my fans.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Looking upon their faces,
it is only natural that a smile would grace
my lips.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To be praised for that anew
is rather embarrassing, I must admit.
choice_data_list: I think it's fine to keep being yo...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
The 'Rose's Blooming Smile' was something
that arose naturally...
That would be for the best.
